initial_attempt.failure: Runner assumed one receipt per window; production emits running before dispatch and terminal afterwards. The second immutable save collided before retaining terminal body.

retained_interpretation_failures.unknown_policy_note: Physical object existence can be explicit while specialized kind remains outside the frozen finite inventory repertoire. This is not source absence.
retained_interpretation_failures.extra_nomination_policy: An additional same-label foreign-register assertion is a distinct literal mention outside targeted gold; it requires source/modality review and cannot automatically be counted as a false positive or merged identity.

adopted_mechanics: Explicit opaque source_slot binds every name/kind/boundary quotation to one supplied original occurrence.
Canonical windows preserve all source text; oversized whole slots or call-budget regions remain visibly unscanned.
Window request JSON hash, versioned guidance hash, status, runtime calls and raw ordered aggregates are revalidated.
Known output truncation cannot qualify as parsed; failed receipts remain visible.
Whole original context is attached by the server; fake model context cannot replace its qualifications.
Progress is an append-only sequence of immutable running/terminal/skipped events; no event overwrites another.
Source-only nomination and graph association/type correction remain separate, with explicit review and no automatic rename/merge/date/event promotion.

test_verification.note: Deterministic/fake-provider mechanics tests, not empirical model accuracy.

primary_engine_activation_verified.qualification: Verified local engine binary/route activation and unchanged graph fingerprints. This is not semantic graph correctness or complete contract accuracy.

proposed_research: Separate original name-span, entity-kind, title/operator boundary, same-occurrence association and abstention targets.

Use independent multilingual training examples and paired hard negatives for record IDs versus parties, proper legal prefixes versus grammatical operators, and people titles versus literal company names.
Treat unsupported-kind policy separately from unclear source meaning; version an expanded equipment ontology in a future experiment rather than rewrite this gold.
Measure false support and selective risk after source-grounding; retain unknowns and operative-role ambiguity.
Keep this frozen evaluation corpus excluded from future training and prompt selection; any feedback-informed subsequent run is development evaluation.
limits: This is the separately retained retry after a failed retention harness, not original first-pass workflow success.
Source-slot mechanical qualification does not certify semantics, operative actions, dates, predicates or native entity identity.
Eight synthetic originals and 36 targeted expectations are not representative legal-contract accuracy or an exhaustive entity inventory.
Recorded source invocations may include provider transport retries; separate HTTP-attempt counts were not measured.
No paired same-corpus model comparison establishes a quality improvement over H512/R740.
No new training or acceleration claim; only integration mechanics and measured source-only error categories.
